prompt:
Create a detailed PRODUCTION SPRITE ATLAS for the approved Cara abstract head in the supplied reference. A SQUARE sheet with EXACTLY 8 columns and 8 rows = 64 distinct frames. Use a large square image, ideally 2048x2048 or larger, so every cell is clear. NO labels, numbers, borders, text, watermarks. Genuine transparent exterior and gutters. All cells equal, one frame per cell, same anchored head center. The design must remain the approved wide rounded pebble face, simple blue ink #2455A6 contour, warm ivory fill, tiny eyes/eyebrows/mouth, and subtle sideways hair suggestion made by the TOP OUTER SILHOUETTE. NO forehead hair strokes, NO baby curl, no body or ears or nose or human anatomy.
STYLE: hand-drawn STOP MOTION, to play at 10 frames per second. Each frame is individually drawn with very slight lively variation: contour boil, a millimeter of line wobble, small changes in eye spacing or eyebrow angle. Keep character identity and overall registration stable, but NOT digitally perfect copies. Crisp minimal blue pen lines, a little uneven ink pressure; no 3D, gradients, halo, glow, shadows, or texture outside the strokes.
FRAME PLAN, read left-to-right each row, rows top-to-bottom:
ROW 1 (frames 0-7), REVEAL FIRST HALF: a tiny blue ink dot at center; short curved dash; tiny spiral; small loose double swirl; spiral expands from center; larger lively swirly scribble; scribble unspools outward into partial left head contour; partial wide head outline forming from the center. Early marks occupy only 5-30 percent of the SAME head area, never zoomed to fill the cell.
ROW 2 (frames 8-15), REVEAL SECOND HALF: upper contour and sideways silhouette flick begin; outline three-quarters drawn with a loose trailing curl; nearly complete outline with ink strand curling inside; completed ivory-filled outline with residual small spiral; clean full outline with one eye appearing; second eye and eyebrows appear; little mouth stroke appears; finished neutral Cara. Last frame matches reference.
ROW 3 (frames 16-23), IDLE LOOP: neutral closed smile, tiny curious eye shift, settle, half blink, closed blink, half-open eyes, relaxed soft smile, neutral settle. Subtle head-contour boil, no rocking or large squash.
ROW 4 (frames 24-31), LISTENING LOOP: head tilted slightly with a lifted, turned pose as if offering an ear toward the speaker, eyes looking up; subtle eyebrow lift, tiny attentive nod over the sequence, blink in the middle, warm closed smile. Each frame retains the listening pose, not neutral forward-facing.
ROW 5 (frames 32-39), THINKING LOOP: eyes glance up-left; brow rises; eyes glance up-right; tiny slanted mouth; one eyebrow arches; eyes briefly narrow; eyes look upward; thoughtful settle. Head only, no hands or thought bubbles.
ROW 6 (frames 40-47), TALKING LOOP: eight clear mouth shapes including closed smile, small round O, small horizontal opening, medium oval, wider bean-shaped opening, small asymmetric opening, round O, closed. Eyebrows and eyes vary gently so she feels alive. NO teeth or tongue. No word labels.
ROW 7 (frames 48-55), HAPPY / DELIGHT LOOP: soft smile grows, open smile, delighted eyes, small laughing smile, closed happy eyes, delighted grin, relaxed happy, soft smile. Restrained charming reactions.
ROW 8 (frames 56-63), FUTURE REACTIONS: confused with one brow raised; skeptical side glance; surprised small O; pleasantly surprised open smile; apologetic little wince; sleepy half-closed eyes; sleepy blink; gentle goodbye expression. No added props, emoji, icons, tears or hands.
Use the whole square atlas evenly. Each face from frame 8 onward fits within roughly 72 percent of its cell width with transparent gutters. Head width/height about 1.25, anchored center consistent. DO NOT put all frames in a long strip. EXACTLY eight rows of eight cells, no title or empty extra cell. Primary objective: a rich usable atlas with a COOL SWIRL-TO-DRAWING REVEAL and slightly imperfect frame-by-frame personality.
